boards.name: Korn Ferry
boards.notes: Homepage, About, Global offices and Partnerships pages state no headquarters, parent, language options, employer pricing or API. The Partnerships page covers sponsorships with Microsoft Dynamics 365 and FORTUNE, not a job-board partner program.

boards.name: LHH
boards.notes: Our Presence page states LHH is part of the Adecco Group. The only locale shown is United States (English). No headquarters, employer pricing, API or partner page found on the pages read.

sources.title: Our Presence page
sources.quote: LHH is an Adecco Group Company

boards.name: Michael Page
boards.notes: The principal place of business given is for Michael Page International Inc., the US entity. The page does not name a parent company; its Corporate site link goes to page.com. No language switcher found in the browser text, so no language codes are recorded. No employer pricing or API found.

sources.title: About us footer
sources.quote: Principal Place of Business: 1156 Avenue of the Americas, 5th Floor, New York, NY 10036, United States.

boards.name: Praca.pl
boards.notes: Ad package prices are net (netto) in PLN, starting at 649 PLN for DUO FORCE. The privacy clause places the operating company's seat in Warsaw and the footer names Praca.pl Sp. z o.o. A free job widget is offered for other sites; it is an outbound display, not an API. No API, developer or partner program page is linked, and no language switcher was found.

sources.title: Footer privacy clause
sources.quote: spółka z ograniczoną odpowiedzialnością z siedzibą w Warszawie

sources.title: Services page
sources.quote: Dołącz do kilkudziesięciu tysięcy firm, które znalazły pracowników na Praca.pl.

boards.name: Incruit
boards.notes: Footer names Incruit Corporation. The homepage address text is garbled, so no headquarters is recorded. The employer product page returned HTTP 502 with blocked true in the browser reader and was not retried. No language switcher or parent company found on the homepage.

boards.name: Banco Nacional de Empregos
boards.notes: The partner page offers BNE job XML to job sites on request by email. That feed runs from BNE to partner sites, so it is not a posting API. The plans page (/cia/escolha-de-planos) redirects to a login page, which was not used, so no prices are recorded. Footer names BNE - Banco Nacional de Empregos.

sources.title: Partner page, job XML feed
sources.quote: Receba nossas vagas em XML para publicar no seu site.

boards.name: Cutshort
boards.business_model: subscription (flat plan by company size); Assisted model charges 8.33% of CTC on hire
boards.notes: Eval API keys are generated by approved employers in Settings. Production access is requested by email, and production keys add job posting. The pricing page describes Freedom plans and an Assisted model. No headquarters, parent, language switcher or partner program found.

sources.title: Pricing FAQ
sources.quote: No usage limits. No seat limits. One flat pricing based on your company size.

sources.title: Pricing FAQ
sources.quote: In the Assisted model only, we charge 8.33% of the candidate's CTC upon a successful hire.

sources.title: Developer docs, key types
sources.quote: adds job posting and candidate messaging

boards.name: Braintrust
boards.business_model: volume-based pricing for AIR; share of measured savings for Nexus
boards.notes: AIR has no public per-interview price. Nexus is priced as a share of the savings it generates. No developer, API or partner page is linked from the homepage, pricing, about or AIR pages, and the footer lists none. No headquarters, parent or language switcher found.

sources.title: Pricing, AIR
sources.quote: AIR is priced on interview volume. There is no public per-interview sticker price.

sources.title: Pricing, Nexus
sources.quote: Nexus is priced as a share of the savings it generates.
